title: CrewAI autolog span attributes and inputs: route every value through _set_sanitized_attribute and _sanitize_value so LLM provider keys never reach the trace
answers: Why does my CrewAI trace show the OpenAI api_key passed to LLM(api_key=...)?
How do I add a new CrewAI Agent, Task, Crew or Flow field to the trace without leaking credentials?
Where are CrewAI span attributes and span inputs sanitized before they are logged?
Why are Agent and Crew span attributes now dict strings instead of pydantic repr strings?
body:
Path: mlflow/crewai/autolog.py:_set_span_attributes handles span attributes for crewai Crew, Agent, Task, LLM, Flow and Knowledge objects; mlflow/crewai/autolog.py:_construct_full_inputs builds mlflow.spanInputs for Task.execute_sync and Agent.execute_task, and patched_class_call and patched_standalone_call build outputs.
Rule: Every attribute written in _set_span_attributes goes through mlflow/crewai/autolog.py:_set_sanitized_attribute, which calls _sanitize_value before span.set_attribute; span inputs are passed through _sanitize_value as a whole dict. Do not call span.set_attribute with a raw crewai object. A crewai BaseLLM is reduced to its model name, and other pydantic models are walked field by field with a reference-cycle guard (Agent.crew -> Crew.agents -> Agent).
Symptom: A provider key passed explicitly to crewai LLM(api_key=...) appeared in trace attributes (agent llm, function_calling_llm, crew manager_llm, planning_llm, chat_llm) and in mlflow.spanInputs, because str() and model_dump() of a pydantic LLM include api_key.
Constraints: Applies to mlflow.crewai.autolog span attributes and inputs. Span outputs are only passed through _sanitize_value, since no CrewAI result type holds an LLM object. Agent and Crew attribute values are now sanitized dict strings rather than pydantic repr strings, a cosmetic change on informational attributes.
applies: mlflow.crewai.autolog span attributes and inputs for any CrewAI object (Agent, Task, Crew, LLM, Flow, Knowledge).
says: The private model provider key is exposed in the trace inputs viewer.
Hide language model provider keys from agent and task execution trace attributes.
Our API secret appeared in the trace details when configuring the model.
Workflow step inputs in the trace UI are leaking third-party access keys.
Ensure provider authentication tokens never appear inside logged workflow inputs or attributes.
search: Sanitization of CrewAI span attributes and span inputs in mlflow.crewai.autolog ensures provider keys are removed by routing all values through _set_sanitized_attribute and _sanitize_value. BaseLLM objects are reduced to their model name, other pydantic models are traversed field-by-field with reference-cycle protection, and span inputs are sanitized as full dictionaries before logging. This prevents explicit API keys from leaking into trace attributes or mlflow.spanInputs, while outputs pass only through _sanitize_value and agent/crew attributes serialize as sanitized dict strings instead of pydantic repr strings.
